name: RuneHero
summary: Rune Hero is a MMOARPG set in the mystical world of Herud, a land of rune magic, treasures, and ancient conflicts. The game blends deep combat strategy, dynamic economies, and diverse gameplay modes for a truly immersive experience. Step into the roles of unique heroes with distinct skill trees and customizable builds. Whether focusing on burst damage, sustained DPS, or survivability, the multi-class system offers endless strategic possibilities. Combine abilities, experiment with synergies, and adapt to conquer any battlefield.
